quotes.text: The TB Tools review guidance says a timed-out browser harness, a wrong test, or a test that misses the changed behavior cannot support a passing-validation claim. A local macOS result also does not prove CI behavior. Apply this when reporting patch validation; it is a reporting limit, not a claim that any listed test failed.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
